learning_outcomes.text: Understand the structural and aerodynamic characteristics of automobiles.
Understand the characteristics of clutch systems, gearboxes, and transmissions commonly used in automobiles.
Be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to transport engineering and the automobile vehicle.
The Automobile Vehicle: Concept, classification, required characteristics, main elements.
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment consists of two partial exams (40% each) and a project (20%). If the continuous assessment is not passed and the project has been submitted, the student may take a comprehensive exam, and the final grade will be the score obtained in this exam. If the course is not passed in the ordinary call, the student may take a comprehensive exam in the extraordinary call, and the final grade will be the score obtained in this exam.
